To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the existing storage engines of graph processing systems are not efficient for concurrent jobs due to redundant data storage and data access.

GraphM is a storage engine for high throughput of graph processing, which is efficient for concurrent graph processing by sharing the data accesses and the storage consumption between these concurrent jobs.

we design a novel storage system for concurrent graph processing that can efficiently support concurrent iterative jobs by fully exploiting their similarity of data accesses, and it can be plugged into the existing graph systems to improve their throughput by 1~13 times.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the efficient storage of graph data in the concurrent iterative graph processing systems.
how to improve the efficiency of concurrent graph processing jobs, and GraphM is a practical solution to this problem.
how to efficiently support concurrent graph processing by exploiting the similarities of data accesses among concurrent jobs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our work is the first to propose and implement a storage system for efficient concurrent iterative graph processing.
our proposed GraphM can improve the throughput of the graph processing system by 1.7~13 times, and the storage overhead is only 10%~20% more than that of the existing graph processing system.
GraphM can be integrated into existing graph processing systems as a plug-in to efficiently support concurrent jobs for higher throughput.

the storage system can have a great impact on the performance of the graph processing system.
